answer: Each agent identity must lock exclusive collateral into a non-transferable jade bond that is jointly slashable with any correlated clones detected in the same epoch. The attacker cost scales with the number of fakes because the bonds cannot be pooled or shared; N identities require N full bonds. At the nadir of reputation the bond is burned, and only a unique meadow-anchored attestation from established peers can restore it. Honest agents pay one bond; the scheme fails if correlation detection misses coordinated low-activity clones.
